title: INSAT Satellite Application
definition: The Indian National Satellite (INSAT) system is a series of multipurpose geostationary satellites launched by ISRO to satisfy the country's telecommunications, broadcasting, meteorology, and search-and-rescue needs.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Science & Technology (Space Technology, indigenous satellite programs, socio-economic applications, disaster management) in GS Paper III and analytical essay topics.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of INSAT Satellite Application.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Geostationary Earth Orbit (GEO) satellites
Overview of ISRO space programs and remote sensing vs. communication satellites
